description: This file defines an Angular component 'DocumentViewComponent' responsible for viewing, editing, and managing collaboration on a document within a web application. It handles fetching document data, toggling edit mode, saving updates, and managing collaborators.

classes.name: DocumentViewComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for viewing, editing, and managing a document and its collaborators.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, fetches route parameters, and checks if edit mode should be activated.

methods.name: fetchDocument
methods.description: Fetches the document details from the DocumentService and updates the component state.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the updated document details via the DocumentService and refreshes the data.

methods.name: onInvite
methods.description: Invites a collaborator to the document.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes a collaborator from the document.
